balls.text: taken by Buttler, as he ends halfway towards where the deep-third fielder was present. Prasidh bowls another short ball, but this climbs up nicely just outside off. Brevis went pulling, but got a top edge flying back over the wicket
bam! What a sound off the bat! Short of a length, and on sixth stump, as Brevis pulled over midwicket with a lovely swing of the bat
ohh, well bowled by Prasidh. He spots Brevis getting across and shaping to a scoop, and bowls short. Goes wide-ish of off, and the ball goes over Brevis' bat
pulled over the man at short fine leg, but not well timed. Short in length on the stumps, and Jadeja has a swivel for a single
a low full toss and just outside off. Whipped to deep midwicket, with the ball tailing into him
a full toss and a bit high on the stumps, as he backs away and pushes it down to long-on
very full, and angling across to middle and off. Driven hard to long-on
yorker length from Siraj on leg, and Jadeja clips this to deep square leg by clearing his front leg. They push for two, and make it
fifty for Brevis off 19 balls, as he drills this much fuller ball on middle and off to long-on

some fortune for Brevis, and it hurts GT. Slower ball from Siraj, who bowls short and a little wide of off. Brevis opens his stance up and goes deep to have a hack, but the ball flies off the top edge to go to deep-backward point
tonked straight down the ground! This ball arrives fuller, and closer to off, as Brevis gets his front leg out of the way, and pumps it back

Shahrukh slips at the long-off boundary... and the ball lands a few rows back. Scrambled seam from Siraj, who goes full and around seventh stump. Brevis doesn't time the loft as well, but he hits forcefully enough
change of pace, and Jadeja is beaten. On the fuller side this time, but again wide of off. Jadeja looks to slash without any foot movement, but misses
on a length, and very wide of off. Left alone by Jadeja
thumped on a few bounces to long-off, as he goes back and across, and attacks at this short-of-a-length ball arriving around fifth stump

he attempts a reverse scoop... and the ball takes the top edge to go over short fine leg!! That's T20 luck for you. Arshad went full and wide of off, and Brevis shaped early to have a swing, but seemed to have done it a bit too early
a high-ish full toss on the stumps, and pushed wide of long-on
finally Jadeja's strike rate goes past a hundred. He prefers pace to spin, and smashes this length ball around off for six to long-off, right where the yellow brigade is present

this lands where a mid-off would have been, after Brevis sends this up ballooning. Arshad angled it across from over the wicket, and went full and pretty wide of off. Brevis threw his bat at it, and ended up chipping it with his bottom hand coming off the bat
shorter side of a length on middle, as he takes pace off again. Brevis pulls it towards square leg off the bottom of the bat
short delivery on leg, and Jadeja mistimes a pull to deep midwicket
yorker length, and swinging into middle. Whipped to deep square leg

slower ball, but it doesn't matter. This time he goes behind the stumps, and gets four even as his bottom hand comes off the bat. Short in length, and on middle from Coetzee, who gets the slower ball to finish on leg. But Brevis swipes at it to beat short fine leg
flung away for another six in the V down the ground! He sits deep in the crease, and lofts this fullish ball swinging into middle. Great strike by slightly opening the face of the bat
on a length, and angling across to pitch on middle and off. Jadeja punches to mid-off, and they hurriedly complete the single
full and dipping, and just outside off. Nudged to deep cover
short of a length outside leg, and pulled on a few bounces to fine leg
on a length, and around sixth stump. Cut away to cover point
quite full and slow, and on middle and off. Pushed to cover
sees Brevis back away, and bowls short on middle. The ball shapes to turn back in, and is swatted to long-off
just clears the boundary down the ground! Rashid tossed it up, and went full and wide of off, but Brevis went low to hammer it back
on a length, and angling across to arrive wide of off. Jadeja punches on the bounce to point
slashed off the top edge, and beats deep third to his right. Prasidh goes on a short of a length, and around fifth stump, as Jadeja looks to slap at it by shifting his weight back
short of a length yet again, and he nearly cramps Jadeja for room by going on middle. Jadeja rides the bounce, and jabs towards point
again goes on the shorter side, and this is on the stumps. Jadeja goes back and across to whip to midwicket, and is sent back by Brevis
short of a length, and just outside off. Punched firmly to deep point
bowls a bouncer first up, as he pitches it around sixth stump. Brevis shapes to play, before letting it go
on a length, and just outside off. A hint of turn back in, and is slapped to deep point
fuller and much slower, as he goes on off. Driven to long-off to get off the mark
shorter side of a length, and just outside off. Cut away to short third

bowled him! Rashid finally strikes. He bowled this on a fullish length, getting it to dip just about on off. The ball turned in, and Conway was too early into his attempted slog sweep. I think the ball was slower too, as Conway swung his bat early and missed. So it will be two new batters at the crease for CSK now
over long-off! The boundary is shorter there, and Conway gets to fifty by slamming it back. Tossed up and dipping on a length around off, as he skipped down the pitch to get to the pitch of the ball
on a fullish length just outside off, and turning in. Punched back to Rashid's left
very full - nearly a yorker - and just outside off. Conway slices it to long-off and nearly loses his balance in doing so
full and slow, and on off. Pushed down to long-on
drilled down the ground first ball! Shahrukh bowls a dipping low full toss on off, and Brevis sends that back straight of long-on

gone! The ball flies to the long-on fielder. Just one ball after being hit for six, Shahrukh gets CSK's big six-hitter. Pretty full from Shahrukh - and slower too - as the ball dipped on middle and off. Dube went heaving at it, but the length seemed to be too full for that shot. Despite that, though, the ball was hit hard and flat, but exactly where Coetzee was waiting for it
crashed over deep square leg! Short in length from Shahrukh, and Dube shifts his weight back to pull this hard from a middle-and-pff line
bowls this wide of off, and on the shorter side. Conway skips down, and slaps to deep cover
fuller and slower, and around sixth stump. Nudged wide of long-on, and they push for two
On a fullish length on middle, and whipped to short fine leg
over cover, and that goes to the deep extra-cover boundary. Tossed up and dipping, and full and wide of off, as Conway throw his hands at this to loft with a flat bat
this is slower from Rashid, who drifts this in, and goes fuller, and outside leg. Conway drives back to Rashid this time
bang! Launched deep over long-on! Conway gets his front leg out of the way, and reads this dipping length ball on the stumps to deposit it for six
full and flay, and just outside off. Dube looks to drive, but gets it off the inside half of the bat towards midwicket
On the fuller side of a length, and angling across to arrive wide of off. Dube reaches out and drives to deep cover point
on a length, and again outside leg. Conway went swiping, but is hit on the side of his leg. The ball dribbles towards square leg
good work by Rashid, who runs and slides to his left to keep this to two. Short in length from Coetzee, and outside off, as Conway cut off the back foot

chipped down the ground! He just goes through the line, and bags four over mid-off. This is an outswinger from Coetzee, who bowls on a fullish length, and on off. Conway lofts with his bottom hand nearly coming off the bat
shorter side of a length, and angling across to pitch on off. Conway mistimes a pull to midwicket
bowls on a length, while swinging this in. It pitches outside leg, and Conway is hit on his front pad as he misses his attempted flick
hint of room outside off, drilled through the covers for one
more towards the pads now and he clips it square for one
smoked down the ground for six! An opportunity to free his arms with width on offer outside off, Dube uses his long limbs to get to the ball and smashes it straight back
good length ball on the stumps, no room and he defends it back

leading edge and Gill settles under it! Patel is attacking everything, and this time Sai Kishore replies with a slightly shorter length once the batter comes down so that he can't reach the pitch of the ball. The ball, as a result, turns before it reaches Patel and his wild swing results in a leading edge towards cover where Gill goes back to gobble it with his shades on
a bit too short, but he also backs away early and pounces on the length to pull it away with some muscle, well over deep midwicket all the way
flatter on middle and leg, he goes back and swats it behind square for one more
pitched up, tonked down the ground, and he bisects long on and long off for another one-bounce four. The 100 comes up for CSK
around good length outside off, he punches it down to mid off for one
Conway makes some room and cuts it away for two in the gap behind square
smashes down the ground after a shimmy down the track and Shahrukh Khan has dropped that tumbling catch running to his left
Starts with a loopy full toss on the pads, flicked away for one
he spoils Sai Kishore's over with a boundary on the last ball. But he got a ball with plenty of width, so he threw his hands at it and lofted it wide of long off for a one-bounce boundary in the gap!
room outside off, probably expecting Conway to come down, and he has to really reach out for that for a single to deep cover
goes for the big shot against the length ball, and they get two quick runs off the slog sweep
a loopy delivery but he lands it in the block hole, Conway bunts it back to the bowler with hard hands
angling into the stumps from wide of the crease, tucked to leg for one
outside off and he slices it away past point for one

poor delivery on leg and that's easily put away for four! This time Patel didn't even have to move towards off. He stands where he is and puts the ball away with its angle, very fine on the leg side again for a one bounce four
too short and straight, Patel gets inside the line and swipes that fine on the leg side, not too far from the keeper and that's four more
pace on again, short of length and towards the abdomen, that one beats Conway and sends him into a tangle but they sneak a leg bye anyway
looked like a slower one, it was fullish outside off and Conway drove it away with a forward lean, through the covers for four
thick edge flies away fine on off and reaches deep third after a bounce. A single
138.3kmh, short of length outside off and he hops back to steer it to point
two fours to the end the powerplay! Not off the bat, but that won't make a difference because it's still four. Angling in too much towards the pads, goes off the pads and fine enough for four more
an acrobatic effort at the rope from Rashid Khan but he can't stop that one-bounce four! Flicked in the air off the legs and that raced away to beat Rashid's right hand running from deep fine leg
pokes at this time and connects to pinch a single towards point
beaten with a beautiful delivery! Outside off on good length, Patel pokes and the ball holds its line after landing on the seam to beat the outside edge
angling into the body from short of length, tucked off the hips for one, even if off the body
strays too much down the leg side for a wide
angling in and the slight seam movement makes Conway a little uncomfortable, he manages to defend it back
tight line outside off to end the over, he slices it late towards point for one

scrambled seam outside off again and punched to cover for one, and oh my, overthrows hand them two more. A needless throw from mid-off is a direct hit, the ball deflects to the leg side where Sai Kishore makes a mess of the slide that leaks two. Siraj is not happy at all
majestic flick for six! He has broken the shackles with a magnificent shot. Pitched up from Siraj, scrambled seam, and Patel pounces on the length with perfect timing, square of the wicket for six

almost fourth dot in a row, but it's gone marginally down leg for a wide. Close call. Angling down for sure, but that didn't go far from leg stump line, and had enough bounce to beat Patel's swipy pull to the leg side
140.5kmh, finally connects for the ball angling in and sends the swipe to midwicket after a bounce
1381.kmh, into the pads now with the angle towards the stumps, Patel goes for a swipe and misses
139.6kmh, he starts with a bouncer and Patel looks surprised but that, hardly ready to pull it away so the ball bounces over him
141.1kmh, nice and quick and angling in to end the over. He defends cautiously
sends in a bouncer that goes well over Conway's head. Called a wide
the short of length ball hurries on to him outside off, he runs it down to deep third for one

skied that down the ground and Siraj takes it nicely over his head! That went really high into the sky with the sun beating down, Siraj is not wearing shades, but he's pedaling back with eyes glued to the ball. And he stretches his arms full length over his head to get both to it. His captain races to him for a hug and pat on the back
mixes it up by going really full and Mhatre wasn't expecting that! He's stuck in his crease and brings out the drive late, the full length and away swing beats him
even shorter outside off, Mhatre goes on his toes for the upper cut and misses!
not surprisingly he bangs it in short around off, Mhatre steers it behind square and another dive stops a few runs
touch wider to end the over, he steers it late towards backward point where Gill dives to save a few with his left hand
much more confident from Conway as he leans into this drive outside off even though the ball wasn't that bad at all. Good length outside off and he uses the angle to middle it through the gap
not much room outside off and he punches it down to mid-off for one
cuts this slightly shorter ball past point for one

and edged for four! He pushes away from the body as Siraj bowls outside off again on good length, he has to go after it, but the soft hands only mean a bit of an edge and it goes between slip and gully for four
angling away from the open face of the bat, beaten first ball

a six to end the over as well! Make that 28 off the over. Arshad has tried almost every length and he finishes off with a bouncer. But the line isn't great, and Mhatre hooks this ball away, fine on the leg side, all the way
just over midwicket, four more! Full delivery on the stumps, hint of inswing into the pads and Mhatre has opened up his stance enough to flick it away with hard hands over the infield for four more

some swing this time, coming in late towards middle stump, and Mhatre has still played that so well it races away for four! Makes room, gets the width to free his arms which he otherwise wouldn't have, and caresses it away through the covers
into the stands this time! Full this time after the short ball, Mhatre stays back and middles that loft, swing through the line and another six over long on
short length again, and it gives Mhatre another chance to pull it away, from down to up a bit like Klaasen, and sends that all the way over long-on for six! Just over the rope
on the stumps and Mhatre smashes it over the midwicket region for two
tries to swipe it away to leg but gets a leading edge to deep third for one
goes hard after this one, trying to smash it over he covers but he's beaten
finally smashes one away, and over the non-striker for four! The crowd loves it
errs down the leg side now, past the swipe for a wide
makes a hint of room and punches it into the off side
132.5kmh, angling in towards the stumps now, Mhatre gets the inside half of the bat on it
short of length to begin with outside off, punches it off the back foot to cover point

Dhoni ends the game by taking the catch to his right!! Is this the final time he has ever done that in the IPL? We might not know that for another year, and that'll be thrill of it all, I think. Short delivery from Kamboj around middle and leg, as Sai Kishore went for the pull but got a top edge. Simple catch for Dhoni, as his side end IPL 2025 with an 83-run win, although that isn't enough for them to not finish last
another length delivery, but this is wider of off. Siraj has a push at it, but gets an outside edge to deep third
on a length, and just outside off. Siraj pushes it towards cover, from where there's an overthrow which allows a second
fullish ball, and dipping on off. Blocked down with a good stride forward
full and straighter, and it takes his pad as he looks to clip. The ball dribbles away behind square
fuller, but again wide of off. Siraj leaves it alone, and it's called wide
angled across, and on a length. It comes wide of off, and Siraj lets it go

bowled him! Finally CSK end Arshad's party. On the fuller side of a length, and just outside off. This time the ball did turn, and came back in. Arshad looked to have another big hoick across the line, and missed. The ball went on to clatter into the stumps
beaten! On a fullish length, and just outside off. The ball doesn't turn, and Arshad looks to swipe but misses
full and just outside off, and sliced aerially to deep-backward point
another fiery short ball. This lands on middle, and zooms off the pitch, as Arshad looks to slash but misses
short delivery on the stumps, and he rides the bounce to jab it to point
short in length on leg, and he's cramped for room as he looks to nudge it. Hit on his thigh there
a bouncer, and wide given. He bangs it on middle, and Arshad lets it go as the ball flies over his head
cracking shot! Arshad showing his batting skills. Short of a length, and on off or thereabouts, as Arshad has a powerful pull over midwicket for six more
just over long-off! It's the shorter boundary there, and Urvil, who was in play all along, eventually left it alone. Pathirana bowled this full on off, and Arshad just launched it down the ground
just past the man at wide slip. Sai went driving at this length ball angling across and pitching off, but got an outside edge. Single to deep third
short of a length on middle and off, and nudged towards midwicket
beaten! This one turns away off a fullish length just outside off, and Sai goes for a jab but sees the ball pass the outside edge
full and just outside off, but turning in. Driven back to Noor's right

slashed to extra cover! Dube there is paced right at the edge of the circle, and takes it in his lap. Noor gave the ball some flight, and went full and wide of off. Tewatia reached out, and looked to go over the in field, but couldn't time or place it well enough
quite full, and just outside off. Sliced aerially over cover
tossed up, and it comes out as a low full toss wide outside off. Driven to extra cover
on a full length, and just about on off. It turns away a bit, and is slapped to point
whipped over deep midwicket! This full ball dips on to him on middle, and Arshad reads it well to have a liberal heave for six
wide ball. Angled in, and full and outside leg. He went hoicking, but missed
full and slow, and drifting in as it pitches on leg. Arshad looks to flick but is hit on his front pad. There's an appeal for lbw, but it was heading down leg
fullish ball on off, and pushed to Hooda's left, where a short midwicket would have been. They get a quick single nevertheless
fuller ball, and slower on middle. Nudged towards deep midwicket for two
reverse swept over point! On a length on off, and a hint of turn away, as Tewatia switches over for an aggressive shot
slower ball, and fullish on off. Pushed to mid-off, and Arshad takes off for a single. But he's sent back, even as there's a direct hit by Hooda at his end

Brevis at point asks if it was a clean catch, but I don't think it was. It seemed to have gone on the bounce. The umpire asks for a confirmation, though. Yup, the ball bounced before going to Brevis. It was a yorker-length ball angling across, and arriving wide of off, as Arshad looked to drive, and got it off the toe-end of the bat

bowled him! The leg stump comes off. Short of a length on middle, and the ball seams back in slightly to hit the leg stump. It kept a bit low too, and Coetzee was beaten as he looked to push forward. I think both the movement back in and the lack of bounce must have played a role there
fuller still from Pathirana, but this time it's nearly of yorker length, and around sixth stump. Coetzee has a slash, but is beaten
driven wide of mid-off! Coetzee gets to the pitch of this full ball just outside off, and times the drive wonderfully well to find the gap between mid-off and cover
short of a length, and just outside off. Coetzee has a heave, but is beaten
full on his pads, and clipped to midwicket to get off the mark

taken by Urvil, who was at long-on, but had to come in a big way to catch it. That was nearly dropped, though, as he seemed to have overrun. Yup, he had to move back to take it eventually. Noor tossed this up at Rashid, and went full on middle and off. The ball dipped on to Rashid, who went slogging across the line again. But this time the ball skied up - he seemed to have misread the slower ball - and Urvil completed the take
much fuller, and slower too. It is around sixth stump, and is tapped to point for a single
on a length, and just outside off. It seemed to be wrong 'un, as Rashid slapped it to deep point
shortish on the stumps, and punched to extra cover
Rashid swings at his countryman for six! On a length, and dipping on off. It shapes to turn away, but Rashid slog sweeps over midwicket
some extra bounce for Pathirana, as he again goes short and around sixth stump. Pulled to long-on off the higher side of the bat
thumped to deep midwicket. Short delivery again, and around off, as Rashid pulls off the front foot for four
short and wide of off. Rashid goes ramping at it far away from his body, but misses. Wide called
change of pace, as he bowls on he shorter side on off. The ball keeps a little low, and is chopped towards point
a bit fuller, and again arriving on middle. Flicked just wide of midwicket for another two
short in length, and on middle. Tewatia leaps in the crease, and clips to deep square leg
on the shorter side of a length on off, and seaming away to finish in the channel outside off. Tewatia has a poke, but is beaten
four dots in a row as Rashid pushes another length ball back to Jadeja
length ball on the stumps, he works it back

the set batter is also gone, the table-toppers are crumbling against the team ranked last. Outside off, bit of turn, and Sai Sudharsan wants to carve this inside out over the 30-yard circle but he can't do that successfully, handling the simplest of catches to point
width outside off, he cuts that straight to point
pretty slow towards off stump, Tewatia goes to off and turns it to leg for one

thick edge to short third and it's taken after a juggle! Pathirana the fielder at the edge of the circle, waiting for the ball after SRK's swipe leads to a thick edge. His first attempt is over his head, then in front of his chest for the juggle and then he finally holds on
ends with a full toss driven straight back down the ground and Brevis does well to dive to his left from long off and saves two
he mixes it up with a slower one full outside off, bunted down to long on for one
they're going after Shivam Dube that's for sure! SRK takes him on again by dancing down and lofts a straight six that's landed well beyond the rope
fuller and wide, slices it away for one to deep point
width on the off side, and he punches it into the covers nicely from the middle of the bat for four more!
fumble in the deep and that's four! He starts with a short of length ball, Sai Sudhrsan pulls it away straight to Urvil Ptel behind square where the ball goes through him
SRK wants to sweep from outside leg but he doesn't connect with this time and the over ends with a dot
full and wide with flight, driven square of the wicket this time for a single
driven elegantly over the covers for four! Nice and slow, pitched up outside off and Sai Sudharsan middles that cover drive, just over the leaping fielder
length delivery just outside off, pushed down to long off for one more
on good length outside off, he pulls it into the ground for one to leg
starts with a googly outside off, pushed square of the wicket for one
pitched up a little and he gets a single down to long on for one
into the stands of yellow fans for six! SRK breaks the shackles for GT by coming down and smashing it over the leg side boundary, over midwicket and all the way
width outside off now, cut away square for one
down the leg side past the batter's pads and goes past Dhoni's gloves as well! Five runs. Dube gets his line wrong well down the leg side and Dhoni's dive wasn't enough
length bal on off stump, he steers it late to backward point
short ball on the stumps, he muscles it away to deep midwicket for one
slow and outside leg, nudges it away off the pads for one
fuller and still wide, he drives it away for one along the ground
flat and outside off, short as well, SRK gets a single past cover this time
102.7kmh, room again outside off, he cuts along the ground to deep point this time
flat and quick to Sai Su as well, but this is way outside off and the batter throws his bat at it, almost upper cutting it over short third because there's nobody in the deep
really flat and quick towards middle and leg, SRK bunts it down to long on
some width outside off and he cuts it away for one
139.7kmh, good length ball on off and it's pushed straight back down to mid off

Khaleel appeals for lbw after thudding the ball into the front pad in front of middle and leg, the umpire doesn't move though as the batters run across for a leg bye. Wasn't a bad shout though, surprised CSK didn't even consider a review
reduces the room, it's stifling on off and he defends it late towards slip
more width this time, he middles the cut but can't beat Jadeja at point
phew, finally some relief for GT as Sai Sudharsan opens the face of the bate nice and late for the shorter ball outside off and it beats both short third and backward point for four
137.7kmh, starts with a length ball around off and he defends it back
a quit finish to the excellent over as SRK charges down for a big swing and misses
almost like an action replay for the ball on off stump and SRK dead-bats it back this time
accurate stuff from Kamboj, on length on off and no option but to defend it

one more gone, CSK are running hot! Rutherford goes after the shorter ball, but he doesn't get hold of this pull and the teenager Mhatre does well to go to his left from mid on and get both hands to it. What a start from CSK!
nice and tight length delivery on off stump, he defends it to leg
on the pads on length and it's clipped away for one
straighter line just outside off, Rutherford heaves on the leg side and he's lucky he didn't edge it behind to the keeper or first slip
beats him first ball! Swing in the fourth over for Khaleel - outside off, width on offer but he shapes it away from the batter and makes him miss

he charges again and he has holed out to deep third! The pressure mounts with two off the first three balls. Buttler dances down, Khaleel sticks to his stifling line around off and it leads to a leading edge off Buttler's swing and Kamboj settles under it nicely well inside the rope
shimmies down for a swing but he only manages an inside edge to deep fine leg for two
136.2kmh, back of length on off now, no room at all and Buttler defends
outside off with the scrambled seam, he straight bats it down to mid off
aims for the stumps this time, top of middle and off, and Buttler turns it to leg with the angle for one. Keeps strike
a couple of steps towards the ball again on off, driven wide of extra cover and he's off the mark with a couple
walks towards the ball outside of and drives it first up down to mid off
edged to slip and Kamboj has struck! Gill comes down again, Kamboj pitches on length again outside off and the ball nearly holds its line to surprise Gill, leading to a thick edge to first slip
smashed for a straight six! That shot had confidence written all over it. Dances down the pitch, it's not taken on the full but he smacks it away towards the sight screen
on length outside off, he straight bats it down to mid on
width outside off, Gill scythes that away for one to deep point
full on middle this time, hint of late swing, and he flicks it down to mid on

driven in the air but in the gap for four! Khaleel pitches it up a bit this time, Gill drives that nicely away from the body, and even though it's in the air for a while, he has bisected the gap between cover and mid off
beaten outside off! It's the left-arm angle from Khaleel, the ball lands right on the seam, and goes away a hint to beat the poking bat
swinging in a fair bit from well outside off, he pushes it down to mid on for one
strays too much on leg, just past leg for a wide
not a poor delivery to start with but Sai Sudharsan has clipped that off the stumps with such timing and wristwork, it's raced away for four! Sublime timing
ends the over with a short ball, but it's quick as well and Sai Sudharsan can't clear midwicket. Only one
